comment: Werewolf Skullball. goals: each werewolf_goal_mid tile in the order the Wiki's route scores them, with the way the ball must cross it (the loc's rotation); the final goal is the first goal again. holes: the four waa_cavewall_skullhole spawnholes south of the first goal; the ball comes out on the walkable tile north of each. arena: the Skullball side of the werewolf cavern, east of the Agility course.
